45 weeks = 45 × 7 = 315 days.  
Add 5 days → total extra days = 320 days.  
Start date: 1114-02-06 (assuming format is DD-MM-YYYY, so 6 Feb 1114).  
Add 320 days:  
1114 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400? 1114 mod 4 = 2, so not leap).  
Days in Feb 1114 = 28. From Feb 6: 28 - 6 = 22 days left in Feb → 22 days used.  
Remaining days to add: 320 - 22 = 298.  
March to December 1114:  
Mar(31)+Apr(30)+May(31)+Jun(30)+Jul(31)+Aug(31)+Sep(30)+Oct(31)+Nov(30)+Dec(31) = 306 days.  
298 < 306, so date within 1114.  
Count: Mar 31 → 298 - 31 = 267; Apr 30 → 237; May 31 → 206; Jun 30 → 176; Jul 31 → 145; Aug 31 → 114; Sep 30 → 84; Oct 31 → 53; Nov 30 → 23; Dec 31 → 23 days into Dec means Dec 23.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 1114-12-23
